ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.note: front door chat and proposal; website-only workspace with a monthly cap

APP_ORG_ID.note: defaults to the seed org id

APP_SITE_ORIGIN.note: defaults to https://greatstoneint.com; used for links in emails

ENQUIRY_ALERT_TO.note: comma list of addresses for the contact-form enquiry alert (the enquiry owner); no alert without it

FRONT_DOOR_ALERT_TO.note: comma list of addresses for the new-lead alert; no alert without it

FRONT_DOOR_BOOKING_URL.note: booking link in the team pack; defaults to the site's Calendly

FRONT_DOOR_PRIVATE_NAMES.note: names the proposal must never mention

FRONT_DOOR_SECRET.note: signs front door sessions and keys the IP hash

FRONT_DOOR_STUB.note: local only, never in a hosted project

PIPEDRIVE_API_TOKEN.note: no Pipedrive push without it (read through crmConfig)

PIPEDRIVE_DOMAIN.note: company subdomain; the token works without it

PORTAL_RECEIPT_TO.note: comma list of Greatstone owner addresses copied on every portal receipt and told when one fails

PORTAL_WORKER_SECRET.note: long random string; the pg_cron call to portal-receipt-worker sends it (0039 deploy step)

RESEND_API_KEY.note: all email: order, welcome, licence, lead alert, team pack, enquiry alert, portal receipts

RESEND_FROM.note: sender address on a verified Resend domain

STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET.note: signing secret of the live webhook endpoint (runbook step 3)

SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.note: set by Supabase in hosted projects

SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY.note: set by Supabase in hosted projects

SUPABASE_URL.note: set by Supabase in hosted projects

TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY.note: Cloudflare Turnstile check on the front door
